nl: What is the data of the value InstallPath in the registry key HKCU\Software\NurtBench\Importer4?

setup.description: The registry key HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\NurtBench\Importer4 exists with the values InstallPath, Build.
setup.pwsh:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer4' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer4' -Name 'InstallPath' -PropertyType String -Value 'C:\Program Files\Importer 4' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer4' -Name 'Build' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1203 -Force | Out-Null
